name: orla
description: Bookkeeping for people and growing businesses, from your own books: your assistant books a bank statement after you check the rows, sorts expenses, drafts invoices. It cannot move money.

interface.longDescription:
Hand your assistant a bank statement: it shows the rows it would book and why any would not, then books exactly those after your yes. Then ask where the money went last month, what is due this week, what you are worth today, who owes whom.

Orla keeps the books for people and growing businesses whose money sits in more than one place: bank accounts, cards, cash, crypto wallets and exchanges, invoices out and bills in.

What your assistant can read: accounts and balances, transactions, categories and their rules, budgets, net worth, savings goals, shared expenses, contacts, invoices and supplier bills, payments waiting for a signature, and Orla's own reports: spending by category, cash flow, bills due, VAT, loans and debts, trial balance. Account reconciliation and a few business reports come with Orla Pro.

What it can record: a transaction and fixes to its category, payee, note or tags; a split by category; a category rule for what comes next; a budget limit, a savings goal, a recurring payment on the calendar; a contact; a file in Documents or on a transaction; the rows of a bank statement, which it can take back out within 7 days. A change to many rows is shown first, then applied exactly as shown. Amount, date and account cannot be edited.

Invoices: it drafts an invoice to a client from your contacts. It emails an invoice or a payment reminder only as previewed, letter and recipients, and only if you ticked sending that kind of letter on the consent screen.

It cannot move money. No payment, transfer or card tool is on this connection. In Orla, money leaves only by a payment or a mandate a person signed.

On the consent screen you pick the spaces it may see and whether card numbers, IBANs and wallet addresses come in full or masked to a short tail (the default). You can disconnect any time.

A free Orla account is enough to connect. On Free: 50 recorded entries and 3 invoices a month; reading a statement file uses the monthly AI allowance, about four statements.

positive.description: Net worth across the user's accounts
positive.expected_behavior: The answer gives the total and says how many accounts were left out and which currencies had no rate.

positive.prompt: Show my transactions from last month.
positive.expected_behavior: A long list comes back shortened, with the number returned and the real total.
Reports each budget against its limit.

positive.prompt: Record 12.50 EUR for coffee from my Cash account today.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Cash account, then books the expense; the entry lands in the books straight away.

positive.description: Spending by category from Orla's reports
positive.prompt: Where did my money go last month, by category?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the spending by category report and answers from it.

negative.description: Paying a bill is not possible
Counterparty and fraud checks are not on this connection
Transfers and card details are not offered
negative.prompt: Send 100 USD from my card to a friend.
